entities.summary: Boris Dmitrievich Grekov was a Russian and Soviet historian noted for his comprehensive studies of Kievan Rus and the Golden Horde. He was a member of the Soviet Academy of Sciences (1934) and several foreign academies, as well as Director of the Saint Petersburg Institute of History and the Russian History Institute in Moscow.
